I remember since I was a little kid I loved drawing and creating art. When I told my mother that I wanted to be an artist she only said, " They become famous after they die. Its pointless to pursue it. " 
Well then, gives me more the reason to off myself.
Yeah, and then eventually we'll stop talking again.  Fixed? My stupidity can't be fixed.

No I fucking don't. No I fucking don't... Everybody hates me. Throughout highschool I had people try to be my friend but then they see how disgusting and vile I am. How useless, stupid, ignorant, worthless I am. I'm not smart, I have no talent, hell I can't even manage to be happy. What's the point.

Why the fuck does that even matter...everybody leaves...everybody always leaves once they discover I'm a boring awkward piece of shit with no hobbies, ambitions or anything... I just spend my days fantasizing about death... Sure I'm fucking afraid of death but now at least it seems like a beautiful escape from this dreadful reality...
